lessonRef.title: Publication, presentation, or reflection: solving applied problems with similar figures

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: A 2 m pole casts a 3 m shadow; a tree casts a 12 m shadow. Tree height?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.
The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.
The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 2 corresponds to DE = 4. If BC = 2, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 12 and 12. Find the altitude.
A 2 m pole casts a 6 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 36 m shadow. How tall is the building?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 16 corresponds to DE = 48. If BC = 16, find EF.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
